reproduction.description: Current catalog schema validates unknown dimension keys and route responses have no registry diagnostics; strict config reader required to distinguish failure from permitted compiled defaults. No new baseline runtime claimed.

qualifications: Advisory catalog dimension-membership feedback only, not full W19/F27/N15 taxonomy, value/case/locale/slot vocabulary, inheritance or customer feed acceptance. Unknown dimensions and no nonblank registered tags do not imply an item cannot rank; historical/manual affinities, defaults, pins and other scoring terms remain. Shared safe implicit contentType is considered only when own tag is absent and a non-derived key is configured; explicit values otherwise receive membership/nonblank checks, not value-vocabulary or learning-readiness certification. Diagnostic basis is the exact response catalog and an uncached best-available tenant registry revision, not an atomic activation snapshot or serving-cache attestation. Stored success/receipts stay immutable and advisory warnings can change on retries as the registry changes. Strict read/parse/config failures produce unavailable, never fabricated empty assurance; no post-commit diagnostic failure changes committed success. Maximum50 samples,64-unit dimension display with truncation indicator and numeric coordinates; total/omitted warning occurrences count the whole catalog. Full package/finding/gate/native/SLO/customer/release obligations remain open. No serving/scoring/SDK/schema/policy/registry changes, new UI/framework/cache/broad suite, installs/builds/cloud/deploy/provision/seed/credentials/customer-data/destructive/commit/push/external actions.
